scope: bounded original V4 validation engineering cost on the largest two unresolved n4 cells; frozen V6 checkpoint and timing

selection.exclusion: Union of 64,48,34,8,8,8 historic cohorts with 168 distinct keys. Intersection of the first two cohorts is 2, every later cohort is disjoint from its predecessors.
selection.order: Within each target cell retain four smallest raw SHA256(ASCII prefix including NUL + 32 bytes decoded from key_sha256); break ties by original_ordinal. Sort union by original_ordinal.
selection.inputs: Only pinned structural validation roster, cell eligibility and historical exclusion identities. No selection based on timing, predictions, targets, or guaranteed inclusion of an exact-500 query.
selection.failure: Stop on changed source, cell/identity/count mismatch, duplicate or shortfall; no replacement, reseeding or redistribution.

measurement.ranking: frozen original V4, four arms with V6 timings
measurement.selection_seal: Independently sort all eligible identities and match full selected rows before reading seven aligned source records.
measurement.workload: In BOTH cells check full eligible neighbor pool identity/count, ordered top 500 with exact similarities and cutoff tie order; actual membership rows <= structural vote upper, causal additions <= actual rows, and per-rank sizes checked. At exactly 500: all eligible selected, exact upper, full reconstructed pool digest, boundary present and zero excluded cutoff ties. Report actually sampled exact-500 count separately.
measurement.science_and_control: Two fresh namespaces, identical original keys and ordinals, model provenance and gates, immutable model, full source/metrics/checkpoint verification; compare physical frames, concatenated SHA and full count after supervisor normal exit. Private rows retained only under ignored paths.
measurement.timing: Per-cell maximum within each repeat of verification + append excluding nested commit and direct budget write on the same row. Retain raw timers, rank subphases, commits, setup and tail separately.
